displayNameCn: 勃艮第女伯爵贝阿特丽丝一世
fullNameCn: 勃艮第女伯爵贝阿特丽丝一世
house: House of Ivrea, Burgundian comital branch
primaryTitle: Countess of Burgundy and Holy Roman Empress
primaryTitleCn: 勃艮第女伯爵兼神圣罗马帝国皇后

events.label: Inherited the County of Burgundy from her father
events.labelCn: 从父亲处继承勃艮第伯国
events.note: As Renaud III's only heiress, Beatrice inherited the County of Burgundy and later brought this major principality into her marriage.

events.label: Married Emperor Frederick Barbarossa
events.labelCn: 与皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨结婚
events.note: The marriage to Frederick Barbarossa took place at Würzburg; sources differ between 9 and 17 June, so only the year is used.

events.label: Was crowned Queen of Germany
events.note: Beatrice received the German royal coronation after her marriage to Frederick Barbarossa.

events.label: Was crowned Holy Roman Empress in Rome
events.labelCn: 在罗马加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇后
events.note: Beatrice received the imperial coronation in Rome during Frederick Barbarossa's Italian policy.

events.label: Was crowned Queen of Burgundy at Vienne
events.labelCn: 在维埃纳加冕为勃艮第王后
events.note: Beatrice was crowned Queen of Burgundy at Vienne, reinforcing the imperial couple's authority in the Burgundian kingdom.

events.label: Died at Jouhe and was buried at Speyer
events.labelCn: 在茹厄去世并葬于施派尔
events.note: Beatrice died at Jouhe in the County of Burgundy and was buried at Speyer.

sourceNote: Neue Deutsche Biographie, 'Beatrix von Burgund'; German imperial regesta for Frederick Barbarossa; Knut Görich, Friedrich Barbarossa; John B. Freed, Frederick Barbarossa: The Prince and the Myth.
notes:
Beatrice was a ruling heiress in her own right, not merely Barbarossa's consort. Her Burgundian inheritance strengthened Hohenstaufen power west of the Rhine and later passed to their son Otto I.

Confidence / caveats: Her birth is variously dated c.1140–1145, so birthYear is left null rather than choosing an arbitrary single year. Sources vary over the precise date of her 1156 marriage and occasionally over the naming/origin of her mother (Agatha is sometimes styled 'of Lorraine' or linked to Montjoie). No reliable specific medical cause of death is used.

Unlinked family (not in roster): father: Renaud III, Count of Burgundy; mother: Agatha of Lorraine; child: Frederick V, Duke of Swabia; child: Frederick VI, Duke of Swabia; child: Otto I, Count of Burgundy; child: Conrad II, Duke of Swabia
